@graph.name: Packing and Unpacking
@graph.description: Full, partial, and fragile-only packing and unpacking, including loading and unloading. Full packing covers the whole home room by room; partial packing covers the rooms or item classes the customer chooses; fragile-only packing covers glass, china, artwork, and other breakables. Client-packed loads are moved and placed, and unpacking puts boxes in their destination rooms. From Flat Rate Movers Martinsburg WV, 736 Williamsport Pike Suite 2, Martinsburg WV 25404. Quoted at one flat rate, agreed in writing before move day. Guaranteed Flat Rate or Your Move is Free!
